paragraphs.text:
The  mortally  wounded  flyer  makes  a  rapid  corkscrew  spiral 
and crashes into the meadow grass. Your party approaches and 
examines its uncanny, mangled form. You sever a few parts to 
serve as trophies and hurry to leave the valley. Before you reach 
the exit, however, you discover that the creature’s limbs have 
deteriorated to a slimy ichor in your packs.

Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Each party member gains 1D6 
Sanity. To leave the valley, go to 613. To search more, go to 645.
